metaDescription: Calculaderia's legal disclaimer. Important information about using the financial calculators and limitations.
title: Legal Disclaimer
intro: Read this important notice before using our calculators to make financial decisions.

notAdvice.title: Not Financial Advice
notAdvice.text: Calculaderia provides educational and informational tools. Calculator results do NOT constitute investment, financing or any other financial decision recommendations.

professional.title: Consult a Professional
professional.text: For important financial decisions (buying a property, significant investments, mortgages), we always recommend consulting qualified professionals: financial advisors, accountants or specialized lawyers.

accuracy.title: Calculation Accuracy
accuracy.text: Calculations are based on standard financial formulas and may not reflect all variables of a real situation. Bank fees, notary costs, insurance and other expenses may not be included.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.text: Calculaderia and its creators are not responsible for decisions made based on calculator results. Use of the tools is at your own risk.

sources.title: Sources and References
sources.text: Our formulas follow Brazilian market practices. For verification, the source code is available on GitHub and can be audited by anyone.
